title: 第三章 辞职第四章 预测正确
content_zh:
...
“老板，来一份三鲜米线。”
...
“老板，来一份酱牛肉。”
...
林夜端着托盘，一口气点了好几份食物。
他太饿了。
记忆中，好像只有在还是小孩子的时候才会这么饿。
那个时候自己发育快，消耗大。
下午两点的食堂几乎没人，林夜随意找了个靠窗的座位，嗅着食物的香气，眺望窗外园林美景，心情格外舒畅。
他夹起一口米线，吹了几下，一口咬下，热气腾腾的米线软糯香甜，又带着汤汁的鲜味和微辣，让他忍不住口内生津。
“嗯~好吃。”
林夜不是个吃货，至少还不至于因为一碗米线而不能自持。
是因为他太饿了。
这种感觉就好像小时候，在外面和小伙伴们疯玩一天，回到家手都来不及洗便迫不及待的伸手拿好吃的。
不仅仅是米线，还有牛肉、鸡腿、红烧肉...
这些能够快速补充蛋白质的东西，让林夜不能自持。
是他身体，在大脑消耗过度的情况下，自发性对食物渴望，继而为身体提高能量消耗。
这是生物本能。
他吃的看起来颇为优雅，速度却不慢，原本要花费十几分钟才能吃完的，这次只花费了短短几分钟。

最重要的是...他还是很饿。
“我还要吃肉。”
林夜又点了一些餐点，直到肚皮撑得滚圆，才算结束。
可是当他一算账的时候，却是忍不住挑起了眉头。
“我吃了一百多？”
像魔都大学这种顶流大学，不仅学费低，餐费也不高，可他一顿饭竟然吃了一百多！
如果放到外面，可能要花费两百以上了。
但...这只是一顿饭啊！
一天起码要吃三顿饭，那他一天吃饭的钱就要好几百？
片刻之后，林夜又笑着摇了摇头。
“我的思维，还是有些迟滞了。”
对于普通人而言，赚钱很难，可对于一个能够学习并掌握所有知识而言的人来说，赚钱还难吗？
content_en:
...
"Boss, please have a serving of rice noodles with three kinds of fresh food."
...
"Boss, please have some soy sauce beef."
...
Lin Ye held the tray and ordered several portions of food in one go.
He is too hungry.
In my memory, it seems that I was only so hungry when I was a child.
At that time, I was growing fast and wasted a lot of money.
There was almost no one in the canteen at two o'clock in the afternoon. Lin Ye found a seat by the window at random, smelling the aroma of the food and looking out at the beautiful garden outside the window, feeling particularly comfortable.
He picked up a mouthful of rice noodles, blew on it a few times, and took a bite. The steaming rice noodles were soft, glutinous, sweet, and had the umami and slightly spicy flavor of the soup, which made him salivate.
"Yeah~ delicious."
Lin Ye wasn't a foodie, at least not one who couldn't control himself over a bowl of rice noodles.
It's because he's too hungry.
This feeling is like when I was a child, I spent a day playing outside with my friends, and when I got home, I couldn’t wait to wash my hands and couldn’t wait to grab something delicious.
Not just rice noodles, but also beef, chicken legs, braised pork...
These things that can quickly replenish protein make Lin Ye unable to control himself.
It is his body that spontaneously craves food when the brain is over-consumed, which then increases energy consumption for the body.
This is biological instinct.
He seemed to be eating quite elegantly, but not too slowly. What originally took him more than ten minutes to finish, it only took him a few minutes this time.
Most importantly...he was still hungry.
"I still want to eat meat."
Lin Ye ordered some more meals until his belly was full and round.
But when he settled the accounts, he couldn't help but raise his eyebrows.
"I ate more than a hundred?"
A top university like Shanghai University of Finance and Economics not only has low tuition but also low meal costs, but he actually ate more than a hundred in one meal!
If you put it outside, it may cost more than two hundred.
But...this is just a meal!
He needs to eat at least three meals a day, so how many hundred does it cost him to eat a day?
After a while, Lin Ye smiled and shook his head.
"My thinking is still a little sluggish."
For ordinary people, making money is difficult, but for a person who can learn and master all knowledge, is it still difficult to make money?
